sources.title: sandeep123/math-dqo-a1-step700 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DQO on MATH (Chen et al., ICLR 2026): alpha*logdet (L+I) with a leave-one-out estimator, alpha=1.0 per the paper. Embedding phi = reference-policy hidden states (matching STRIDE) rather than the paper's pretrained sentence encoder, so the comparison isolates the diversity objective.
